usedFor: Flutterwave collects payments, and Asana gets a project when “Create Project” follows “New Subscription”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscription” in Flutterwave, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber opens an Asana project, so onboarding work starts the moment they pay.

watchOut: “New Subscription” is polling, so the project is created after a scheduled check, not at payment time.
